q: "Runa is prettier than most other girls in the class." (Make it positive)
o: Very few girls in the class are as pretty as Runa.
Most girls are as pretty as Runa.
No other girl in the class are so pretty as Runa.
Runa is the prettiest of all in the class.
e: "than most other" বা "than few other" থাকা comparative বাক্যকে positive degree-তে বদলাতে এই ক্রমে বসাতে হয়: Very few + (most other-এর পরের অংশ) + plural verb + as + adjective-এর positive form + as + মূল বাক্যের subject। এখানে Runa is prettier than most other girls in the class থেকে হয় Very few girls in the class are as pretty as Runa। বাকি বাক্যগুলো superlative বা অন্য অর্থ দেয় কিংবা গঠনে ভুল।
